objective: Connect the existing InferencePage Run action to the existing InferenceController and QtInferenceWorker on a QThread, implementing only the asynchronous running, success, failure, cleanup, and rerun lifecycle without MainWindow integration or inference-result rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Constructing InferencePage remains side-effect free: no QThread or QtInferenceWorker is created and no inference starts until Run Inference is activated.

Run Inference builds the request through the existing _build_request mapping and executes it through the injected InferenceController using QtInferenceWorker on a QThread, with the backend observed off the GUI thread in tests.
While a run is active, the status reports Running and the Run button plus every request input control are disabled so overlapping runs cannot start.
A successful worker signal produces a Finished terminal status, and a failed worker signal produces a Failed terminal status with concise propagated error information.

Both success and failure quit the thread, schedule worker deletion from the worker terminal signal, schedule thread deletion after thread completion, clear the page's strong worker/thread references after completion, and restore the controls only when cleanup permits a new run.
After either a successful or failed run has fully cleaned up, the same page and controller can start another run.
The existing Phase 6B inference core, InferenceController, and QtInferenceWorker public interfaces remain unchanged.

Focused qtbot tests use injected fake backends and synchronization primitives; they verify lifecycle state, GUI-thread-safe terminal handling, overlap prevention, cleanup, and rerun behavior without executing real model, CUDA, or image inference.
No MainWindow integration, inference-result or image rendering, preview, cancellation, generic ViewModel/base-page abstraction, or CP3 functionality is added.

Automated screenshot verification is not part of this checkpoint; deterministic widget text/enabled-state assertions, thread-affinity observations, signal outcomes, and lifecycle-reference cleanup are the substitute verification.
claude_prompt: Implement only Phase 6C checkpoint 2 in the two allowed files. Extend the existing InferencePage so its Run Inference action first uses the unchanged _build_request mapping, then creates a QThread and image_ai_studio.gui.qt_inference_worker.QtInferenceWorker for the injected InferenceController. Preserve construction-time side-effect freedom: initialize lifecycle references to None if needed, but do not create a thread or worker or start inference until Run is activated. Follow the repository's canonical lifecycle exactly: move the worker to the thread; connect thread.started to worker.run; connect worker.finished and worker.failed to real QObject-bound InferencePage methods; connect both terminal signals to thread.quit and the worker's own deleteLater; connect thread.finished to thread.deleteLater and to page cleanup that clears strong references. Keep terminal result/error state long enough to show Finished or a concise Failed message, and restore the Run button and all request inputs only when lifecycle cleanup permits a safe rerun. Prevent overlap even if the click handler is invoked directly while active. Add focused qtbot tests to tests/gui/test_inference_page.py using injected fake InferenceController backends plus synchronization primitives. Verify no construction-time execution, backend execution off the GUI thread, Running status and disabled controls, success and failure outcomes, overlap prevention, eventual thread/worker reference clearing, and a subsequent run after cleanup. Reuse the existing controller and worker public APIs without modifying them. Do not modify MainWindow; do not render predictions, probabilities, images, or previews; do not add cancellation, CP3 behavior, generic ViewModel/base-page abstractions, actual model/CUDA/image inference, shell commands, or changes outside the allowed files. Automated visual verification is unavailable, so use deterministic widget state, signal, thread-affinity, and cleanup assertions instead.
estimated_scope: Small-to-medium: modify one existing GUI page and its focused test module, approximately 180-300 changed lines combined.
